# Contributing

Keep changes focused and describe their impact. Follow existing project naming,
formatting, architecture, and dependency conventions. Use the build, lint, and
test commands documented in the README and existing dependency manifests; do not
claim checks passed unless they were run.

Include reproducible, synthetic examples. Never upload `.env` files, credentials,
personal conversations, customer records, private cloud identifiers, or screenshots
containing them. See the security and privacy policy before reporting a leak.

Preserve dependency lockfiles, upstream notices, and existing licenses. A missing
license is not permission to relicense third-party code. Prefer pull requests for
behavior changes, and document intentional compatibility changes.
